title: observability-weekly-2026-10-05
content:
Observability team weekly notes: week of 2026-10-05

Summary:
- Focus this week: tracing ingestion reliability, dashboard flakiness on region EU-W, and prototype cost-telemetry pipeline for Dedicated customers.
- Main wins: tracing backfill completed for 2026-09-28..2026-10-02 window; new dashboard caching reduced load by ~18% on staging; initial S3 staging retention policy for cost telemetry validated.

Standup highlights (daily):
Mon 2026-10-05:
- Marcus: Finished trace backfill job (OBS-412). Verified span schema consistency for Redwood-internal and partner adapters. Found ~0.6% malformed spans - wrote a validator patch (PR #278).
- Priya: Investigated EU-W dashboard refresh failures, root cause = short-lived redis connections from dashboard proxy under high load. Applied connection pool limits in staging.
- Sofia: Cost-telemetry PoC ingest hooked to billing events; found duplicate events from event-emitter v1 when retries happen.

Tue 2026-10-06:
- Marcus: Tracing pipeline unit tests added for malformed-span cases. Deployed validator to canary; no customer impact.
- Priya: Dashboard proxy patch rolled out to staging; refresh errors dropped from 12%->2% in canary region. Need load test for burst >500 req/s.
- Liam: Started implementation of sampling rules UI for console (spike).

Wed 2026-10-07:
- Team sync: Decided to prioritize tracing ingestion SLA (SLO target: 99.9% ingestion success within 60s).
- Action: Add ingestion alerts (error rate, lag) to oncall runbook.
- Elena: Prototyped cost-telemetry dedupe layer using event-id windowing. Observed >98% dedupe in test data.

Thu 2026-10-08:
- Incident review: EU-W dashboard partial outage on 2026-10-08 09:12-09:34 UTC. Root cause: upstream redis failover + proxy conn pool exhaustion. Postmortem doc draft (linked). Action items: add circuit-breaker in proxy, set redis client to backoff jitter.
- Sofia: Began work to surface per-route cost estimates on console (mock data for embed/resp tokens).

Fri 2026-10-09:
- Weekly retro + plan: roll validator & dedupe to production next week behind feature flag.
- Oncall notes: increased paging threshold for ingestion-lag alert to reduce noise; re-evaluate after 48h.

Open items / blockers:
- Production rollout of trace validator needs load testing (owner: Marcus, due: 2026-10-12).
- Sampling rules UI requires API changes to snapshot sampling policies (owner: Liam, blocker: backend API schema design).
- Cost-telemetry timeline unclear for Dedicated customers - need alignment with product (owner: Sofia, ask: sync w/ Heather (product-dedicated) next Tue).

Metrics / telemetry highlights:
- Traces ingested (avg): 42k spans/sec across regions (peak EU-W 11k).
- Tracing ingestion success: 99.86% last 24h (target 99.9% - gap 0.04%).
- Dashboard refresh error rate (EU-W staging): 2% after proxy patch (was 12%).
- Cost telemetry dedupe rate (PoC): 98.3% on synthetic replay.
- Oncall noise: ingestion-lag alerts 14 over last 7 days, reduced from 36 after threshold tweak.

Decisions made:
- Prioritize ingestion SLA and alerting over feature rollout for next sprint.
- Roll forward dashboard proxy connection pooling and implement circuit-breaker pattern as follow-up.
- Ship cost-telemetry dedupe in feature-flagged mode to limited Dedicated customers for beta.

Action items (with owners):
- Marcus Chen: run load tests for validator + finalize PR #278 (due 2026-10-12).
- Priya Kapoor: implement circuit-breaker in dashboard proxy and schedule chaos test for redis failover (due 2026-10-14).
- Liam OConnor: finalize sampling API proposal; pair with backend on schema (due 2026-10-11).
- Sofia Martinez: schedule product sync with Heather re: Dedicated timeline; prepare per-route cost mockups for Console team (due 2026-10-13).
- Elena Rubin: harden dedupe windowing logic and add metrics for duplicate-ratio per-customer (due 2026-10-12).

Meeting notes / links:
- Tracing roadmap sync (Tue): notes -> https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Tracing+Roadmap
- Postmortem: EU-W dashboard outage -> https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/EU-W+Dashboard+Outage+2026-10-08 (draft)
- PRs: validator patch -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/278
- Jira: OBS-412 (trace backfill), OBS-431 (dashboard proxy fix)

Notes to self / messy bits:
- Need better correlation id between billing events and ingestion-time spans - currently relies on event-id and sometimes missing in older adapters.
- Quick hack in staging: increased retry window for event-emitter to avoid near-duplicate retries; must revert when dedupe layer in.
- Meeting with infra next week to discuss dedicated S3 retention for cost telemetry exports (SLA implications).

Risks / escalations:
- If ingestion success does not meet 99.9% by next checkpoint, consider temporary sampling increase for non-production tenants.
- Cost telemetry duplication could skew billing-estimates for Dedicated customers; product must sign off before beta.

Next week's plan (high level):
- Lock down validator rollout + load test.
- Dashboard proxy circuit-breaker + chaos test.
- Push cost-telemetry dedupe to feature flag in prod for 2 selected Dedicated customers.
- Begin work on sampling rules API contract.

Attachments / artifacts:
- Logs: s3://redwood-obs-logs/traces/2026-10-05-backfill/*.gz (staging)
- Grafana dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/observability/trace-ingestion-overview

If anything urgent, ping #observability on Slack or call Marcus/Elena directly.

-- Sofia
